name: Firbolg
heading: Giant-kin, Firbolg
sourceDistinctions: Uses the PHBR10 AD&D player entry. No traits from the fifth-edition firbolg are used.
PHBR10 provides no base movement for Firbolg. Used the matching Monstrous Manual rate of 15, without transferring that entry’s natural AC, Hit Dice or THAC0.
Detect Magic is the AD&D PHB wizard version for duration and area, with an effective caster level equal to actual class level as a table ruling.
The NPC uses the human-made great club from PHBR10 pp. 112, 114 and therefore gets no Strength bonus on attacks or damage with it.

name: Voadkyn
heading: Giant-kin, Voadkyn
sourceDistinctions: Uses PHBR10’s player entry for the wood giant. The Monstrous Manual supplies movement only.

The rules state a 50% range increase and 1d8 arrow damage but give no range bands. The example starts with the AD&D PHB’s longbow sheaf-arrow bands and increases each by 50%. It uses PHBR10 Table 7 speed factor 10.

The forest maneuver explicitly mentions one arrow, so it is an alternative to the two stationary longbow shots. The entry does not supply distance limits for the out-and-back movement. The example assumes accessible cover.

name: Saurial
heading: Saurial
sourceDistinctions: One player profile covers the four printed choices. The original NPC and portrait use the finhead.
The printed ability-range table abbreviates the finhead inconsistently as fn and fh. Its accompanying prose identifies the lineage as finhead, used here throughout.
PHBR10 provides the flyer’s air speed. The contemporary Saurial creature entry supplies the NPC finhead’s ground speed of 12. All other mechanics come from the player profile and core rules.
PHBR10 pp. 113–114 supplies the finhead broadsword. The sample interprets the listed claw pair and tail as alternative routines and places the shield out of hand before using two claws.

name: Swanmay
heading: Swanmay
sourceDistinctions: Uses PHBR10 as the player profile. The human form uses natural AC 7 with the character’s Dexterity adjustment. The sample uses AC 7 as listed in swan form and does not import a creature attack.
PHBR10 makes the shift at will but gives no combat timing. The NPC takes one full round to shift as a table ruling. On-foot human movement uses the AD&D PHB baseline.

name: Sand Giant
heading: Sand Giants as Characters
sourceDistinctions: The player package starts on printed p. 58 and continues on p. 59. The NPC has an original ability array, feat choice and role. Fighter 1 gives total HD 16 and ECL 20. Its CR uses +1 for an associated class level on the printed CR 10 giant.

The MMIII glossary gives a standard action for spell-like abilities unless noted, so the sample uses a standard action for Statue. The related spell and the general Revised SRD spell-like timing would take one round, a possible alternate reading.

Both printed blaster DCs equal 10 + half the 15 racial Hit Dice + the respective Constitution modifier, including the Fighter 5 champion. This NPC therefore uses DC 23. This NPC uses untyped weapon damage and a standard action to fire the blaster, since the book gives neither damage type nor firing action.
